register_io_source: register a python generator function as a polars IO source with a specified schema
scan_my_source: scan a custom python source and return a polars LazyFrame for lazy evaluation
test_my_source: test a custom polars IO source with filter and select operations on collected dataframes
create_lazyframe_filter: create a lazyframe and filter rows using a polars column expression predicate
create_lazyframe_select: create a lazyframe and select specific columns from collected results
